items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: We played a battle of music at the Savoy Ballroom. We had 5,000 people in that ballroom with this particular band against Chick Webb.

ctx.x: We played a battle of music at the Savoy Ballroom. We had 5,000 people in that ballroom with this particular band against Chick Webb. I hate to say it, but we won.
